content.comment_body: Hello, I'm having trouble downloading a program from my PC to a [product_name] module. The download doesn't complete; the device display shows a half-filled bar before freezing. However, I can factory reset it using the cursor keys. Any advice on how to resolve this issue?

For the newer hardware version, you need the latest [product_name] software, specifically [product_name] Comfort [version_no]. Only with this version can you select the latest hardware in the software.

I reviewed forum suggestions and followed advice to turn off the Windows firewall, after which I was able to download the program successfully. Previously, I didn't face this issue with earlier hardware and software versions. Why is disabling the firewall now required? Can someone provide a solution for this new situation?

Hello, With this hardware version, it becomes selectable only in the updated software version. I faced similar problems; even after disabling my PC firewall, the issue persisted. Switching to another laptop resolved it, suggesting some TCP/IP problem. My suggestions: try with a different PC or laptop with the same program and updated software; if connecting via LAN, use another cable; if using a router, verify gateway address, IP, and DHCP settings; and ensure the CPU is in STOP mode. Hope this helps.
I use Windows firewall and don’t need to disable it for program downloads. Not sure why you do. Which operating system are you using?
I wanted to be certain, as programs can't be downloaded if the device is in RUN mode. Maybe my precaution wasn't necessary, but I just wanted to share my experience.
Programs can only be transferred while the CPU is in STOP mode. The software prompts you to confirm this via a pop-up, so there's no need for extra checks.
I understand. Maybe your experience differs. My suggestions are meant for users experiencing issues with the updated software version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report issues downloading programs to the [product_name] hardware, experiencing freezes that require factory reset for recovery. Main concerns are compatibility between software and hardware, unexpected need to disable the Windows firewall, and network-related TCP/IP difficulties. Some users find firewall changes unnecessary, highlighting inconsistencies and reliability challenges.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek a smooth and dependable program download experience without needing to alter security or system settings such as firewalls. They expect straightforward compatibility and minimal troubleshooting for new hardware and software releases.
